assets.icon:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset: final production square app icon for ParkinSUM Companion, 1024 x 1024.
Reference image 1 is the existing blue/green ParkinSUM icon and is the SHAPE/SEMANTIC source. The user explicitly prefers this meaningful figurative shape, simplified, not a generic P or book monogram. Reference image 2 is an actual-font and actual-palette specimen from the app, ONLY a palette/style reference; do NOT copy its text into the icon.
Redesign the reference icon with the recognizable LEFT-FACING HUMAN HEAD PROFILE and rounded head contour, combining a tiny branching neural symbol in the cranium, ONE graceful leaf in the lower neck, and ONE capsule to the lower right. Keep those four meanings but ruthlessly simplify: three neural endpoints max, one central junction, thick smooth strokes, one leaf with one clean slit vein, capsule with one dividing line. Integrate the head and neck into a gently P-like continuous silhouette similar to original, with generous clean negative space. Large single coherent symbol, no tiny details. The head should be the primary silhouette; leaf and capsule should feel integrated, not a pile of pictograms.
Warm editorial identity inspired by Source Serif 4's humanist curves and the actual Paper interface. Palette only terracotta #A84B2A, warm ivory #F6F1E6, light clay #D97757; use restrained flat fills. Ivory profile/neck against a rich terracotta rounded-square tile, terracotta neural lines in the ivory head, complementary clay where needed; capsule and leaf remain visible. Ultra-clean professional vector-like edges, optical balance, softly rounded corners. Flat 2D, no gradients, no drop shadows, no embossing, no glass, no grain, no 3D, no photographic texture, no blue or green. Avoid decorative dots outside the symbol. No words, no letters, no captions, no grids or branding boards.
A single icon fills a square canvas, centered with about 12% internal padding. Make it look legible and distinctive at app icon sizes. Tile corners clean; background beyond tile, if any, same warm ivory. Output only the icon artwork.
assets.logo:
Use case: logo-brand. Create the finished horizontal logo lockup for ParkinSUM Companion, generous wide landscape canvas about 3:1, 2400 x 800 if supported.
Reference 1 is the APPROVED new warm icon shape. Preserve this exact shape and relative composition faithfully: left-facing ivory human profile with three-endpoint terracotta neuron, single clay leaf and capsule in lower right on terracotta rounded-square. Do not redesign its geometry. Reference 2 is a specimen rendered DIRECTLY FROM THE PROJECT'S ACTUAL bundled Source Serif 4 Display Medium and Italic font files; reproduce that wordmark letterform as closely as possible, including the lowercase k and capital SUM. This is the typographic authority, not a generic serif substitute.
Layout: small precise icon at left, large wordmark to its right on a single baseline. Exact main text 'ParkinSUM' (P a r k i n S U M) in Source Serif 4 Display Medium from the specimen, deep warm ink #2A2420 for 'Parkin', terracotta #A84B2A for 'SUM'. Keep the whole word optically connected, no space between Parkin and SUM. Below the wordmark, left aligned with P, exact text 'Companion' in the specimen's restrained Source Serif 4 Display italic, much smaller, warm muted brown. No other text. Compact polished typesetting, thoughtful kerning, horizontal wordmark visually balanced against icon. Wide unobtrusive margins (about 8%). Icon about 48% of canvas height. Main wordmark approximately 5 times icon width at most, fit all artwork naturally; should read beautifully at a displayed width of 620px.
Background a perfectly even warm ivory #F6F1E6 edge to edge. Flat editorial identity, extraordinarily crisp print-like outlines. No mockup, no physical business card, no perspective, no drop shadows, no extra ornaments, no gradients, no border, no labels. Output a single clean complete logo, not a brand presentation board.
assets.github_card:
Use case: ads-marketing / logo-brand. Create one final, flat, front-facing GitHub project showcase / social preview card, a 2:1 wide landscape composition at exactly 1280 x 640 pixels if supported (or high resolution exact same 2:1 ratio). This is the actual shareable digital graphic, not a physical card mockup.
Reference 1 is the NEW ParkinSUM icon. Use exactly its warm meaningful head/neuronal branches/leaf/capsule silhouette as the brand mark. Reference 2 is ACTUAL type rendered from bundled Source Serif 4 Display and Geist fonts used in the project's Paper UI; use its letterforms, typographic elegance and palette as the authority.
Create a highly polished understated warm editorial identity, like a contemporary research notebook publisher. Broad warm ivory #F6F1E6 background, very subtle paper texture if any, dark brown #2A2420 text, warm terracotta #A84B2A emphasis and muted ochre #A8874A thin details. Abundant negative space, clear asymmetric hierarchy, no glossy effects.
Composition: left approximately 70% holds restrained editorial typesetting, right approximately 25% displays the recognizable icon in a warm terracotta tile centered vertically. Leave enough separation. No duplicated tiny icon. All text and icon inside at least 64px safe margins, complete and uncropped. A thin restrained ochre horizontal rule separates footer.
Text MUST be exactly:
Small top eyebrow: 'ParkinSUM Companion'
Largest headline, Source Serif 4 Display Medium from reference, on ONE LINE: 'ParkinSUM'
Short serif subheading below on two naturally spaced lines if needed: 'A local-first' and 'research notebook.'
Smaller Geist supporting line: 'Meals, medication & evidence context'
Footer above/below rule as fits, Geist or Geist Mono small but readable: 'Educational prototype · Synthetic demos'
Bottom footer in discreet but still readable type: 'github.com/albertzhzhou-droid/ParkinSUM'
Small secondary line: 'Not medical advice.'
Use the capitalization above exactly, including uppercase SUM and lowercase repo owner. Make headline big and crisp, supporting line highly legible at social preview size. Do not add dates, metrics, badges, efficacy claims, clinical claims, fake screenshots, stock photos, QR codes or unrelated slogans. Artwork should be sophisticated and inviting, visibly coherent with the attached actual Source Serif 4 sample. No watermarks, no 'GitHub card' title. One card only.
